metadata.title: The Bell at Dusk
metadata.summary: Two neighbors investigate why a silent station bell rang at sunset.
metadata.author: Your Name

cast.name: Mara Vale
cast.description: A practical baker who trusts what she can verify.
cast.public_voice: Direct, warm, and impatient with superstition.

cast.name: Oren Pike
cast.description: The station caretaker, protective of its history.
cast.public_voice: Measured and precise, especially when withholding something.

locations.name: Old Hill Station
locations.description: A disused rail platform whose bell has no rope.
locations.purpose: A compact meeting place for discovery and confrontation.
locations.atmosphere: Cooling stone, flour on the wind, and a bell that should be silent.
locations.presentation_copy: The old station waits above town, its bell dark against the sunset.

truth.statement: Oren rang the station bell using a temporary blue cord.

secrets.statement: Oren rang the bell to warn Mara that the hillside path had collapsed.

clues.name: Blue thread
clues.description: A fresh strand caught on the bell wheel.

beats.title: The Impossible Bell
beats.summary: The station bell rings at dusk and Mara finds blue thread on its wheel.

beats.title: A Question on the Platform
beats.summary: Mara asks Oren whether the bell was a warning; he admits what he did.

routines.activity: Inspecting the bell and watching the damaged hillside path.
routines.public_activity: Closing the old station for the evening.
